_comment: Tolerated high/critical npm advisories (QG-S2). Only unpatched dev/release tooling (semantic-release, markdownlint-cli2, never shipped in the app runtime). The expiry is 30 days (an assumption, starting value; chosen by the owner on 2026-10-29), so upstream fixes get picked up soon; when it passes, tools/check/supply/check-audit.mjs fails so each entry gets re-reviewed: look for a patched release first, then extend with a new reason or remove the entry.

entries.reason: re2js 2.8.6 (patched 2.8.7) is pinned exactly by markdownlint 0.42.0 (latest), pulled in by markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0; lints only our own docs, dev tooling only. markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3 would bring back two high markdown-it advisories. No overrides: wait for a markdownlint release.

undici 6.29.0 is frozen inside the npm CLI bundled by @semantic-release/npm 13.2.0 (npm 11.21.1, latest, via node-gyp); release tooling only. No overrides: wait for an npm release that bundles undici >=6.29.1.
